providers.title: Providers
providers.subtitle: Configure upstream channels and credential pools.
providers.empty: No providers yet. Add one to route traffic upstream.
providers.selectPrompt: Select a provider to inspect credentials and settings.

base_url.label: Base URL
base_url.description: Default upstream origin used when no exact endpoint override is configured.

auto_refresh_models.label: Refresh the model list from upstream
auto_refresh_models.description: Asks this provider what it serves when a client lists models. Off keeps the list you maintain by hand.

enable_openai_magic_cache.label: OpenAI magic-string cache
enable_openai_magic_cache.description: Recognizes supported trigger strings and writes explicit OpenAI cache breakpoints.

enable_claude_magic_cache.label: Claude magic-string cache
enable_claude_magic_cache.description: Recognizes supported trigger strings and writes explicit Claude cache breakpoints.

claude_gateway_fallback_mode.label: Claude refusal fallback
claude_gateway_fallback_mode.description: Retry a refused Claude request on the recommended model or your ordered model list.

claude_fallback_mode.label: Claude fallback mode
claude_fallback_mode.description: Turns fallback off, uses the upstream default, or applies an explicit model chain.

claude_fallback_models.label: Claude fallback models
claude_fallback_models.description: Comma-separated models tried in order when fallback mode is Models.

region.label: AWS region
region.description: Selects the regional AWS endpoint used by this channel.

video_output_s3_uri.label: Video output S3 URI
video_output_s3_uri.description: S3 destination where generated video output is written.

location.label: Vertex region
location.description: Google Cloud region used to build Vertex AI endpoints.

oauth_client_id.label: OAuth client ID
oauth_client_id.description: Client identifier used when this provider obtains an OAuth token.

oauth_client_secret.label: OAuth client secret
oauth_client_secret.description: Client secret paired with the configured OAuth client ID.

oauth_token_url.label: OAuth token URL
oauth_token_url.description: Token endpoint used to obtain or refresh OAuth access.

profile_arn.label: Kiro profile ARN
profile_arn.description: AWS profile ARN Kiro uses for account-scoped requests.

auth_base_url.label: Authentication base URL
auth_base_url.description: Overrides the channel's default authentication service origin.

tier.label: Service tier
tier.description: Upstream service tier selected for this provider.

console_base_url.label: Console base URL
console_base_url.description: Origin used for channel control-plane and console requests.

access_token.label: Access token
access_token.description: Current bearer token sent to the upstream service.

refresh_token.label: Refresh token
refresh_token.description: Long-lived token used to rotate the upstream access token.

api_key.label: API key
api_key.description: Secret API key used to authenticate upstream requests.

client_email.label: Service account email
client_email.description: Client email from the Google service account credential.

private_key.label: Service account private key
private_key.description: Private key used to sign Google service account assertions.

project_id.label: Google Cloud project ID
project_id.description: Project that owns the upstream Google Cloud resources.

cookie.label: Session cookie
cookie.description: Authenticated browser session cookie used by the channel.

account_uuid.label: Account UUID
account_uuid.description: Upstream account identifier associated with the browser session.

github_token.label: GitHub token
github_token.description: GitHub token used to authenticate Copilot requests.

access_key_id.label: AWS access key ID
access_key_id.description: Public identifier for the AWS signing credential.

secret_access_key.label: AWS secret access key
secret_access_key.description: Secret key used to sign AWS requests.

session_token.label: AWS session token
session_token.description: Temporary session token paired with the AWS access keys.

settings.description: Edit the provider's typed endpoint, channel, and advanced settings.

trafficPolicy.title: Forwarded metadata
trafficPolicy.description: Choose which caller metadata this provider may forward through its channel.
trafficPolicy.blacklist: The global credential, cookie, proxy-chain, and hop-by-hop blacklist is always enforced and cannot be overridden here.

request_headers.label: Request headers
request_headers.description: One lowercase header name or trailing-* prefix per line. Accept and Content-Type remain universally allowed.

response_headers.label: Response headers
response_headers.description: One lowercase header name or trailing-* prefix per line, returned from upstream to the caller.

request_query.label: Request query parameters
request_query.description: One case-sensitive query parameter name per line.

form.channelHint: Channels come from this running GPROXY binary.
form.channelCapabilities: {{count}} declared routes across these operation groups
form.labelHint: Optional display text. The route name remains the stable routing identifier.
form.credentialStrategyHint: Round robin rotates requests; sticky keeps each API key on a stable credential.
form.proxyHint: Overrides the instance proxy for this provider. Credentials can override it again.
form.settingsHint: Advanced JSON escape hatch. Declared fields above remain the normal editing path.
form.createError: Could not create the provider. Check the fields and retry.
form.updateError: Could not update the provider. Retry.

fingerprint.title: Client fingerprint
fingerprint.description: Override the channel's default headers and transport profile.
fingerprint.hint: Configured fingerprints fail loudly when no usable emulation can be built.
fingerprint.presetError: Could not load fingerprint presets. Retry.

budget.title: Spending limits
budget.description: USD at gateway model prices, counted from configuration. Blank means unlimited; zero stops paid requests. Resets at 00:00 UTC daily, Monday weekly, and the first of each month. In-flight requests may exceed the limit.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.empty: No credentials yet. Add one before enabling traffic.
credentials.label: Credential label
credentials.kindHint: Records how this credential was obtained for listing and refresh behavior.
credentials.keepSecret: Leave empty to keep the stored secret.
credentials.secretRequired: Enter at least one credential field.

healthReset.hint: Click the badge to clear the recorded health state.
healthReset.error: Could not clear the health state.

quota.empty: The usage endpoint reported no quota windows.
quota.title: Upstream quota

quotaReset.confirmDescription: This spends one credit to reset the eligible Codex rate-limit windows.
quotaReset.error: Could not consume the reset credit.

outcomes.nothing_to_reset: No eligible rate-limit window needs resetting.
outcomes.already_redeemed: This reset request was already redeemed.

credentials.createError: Could not add the credential. Check the secret and retry.
credentials.updateError: Could not update the credential. Retry.

endpoints.title: Endpoint overrides
endpoints.hint: Override only operations that must use a different absolute URL.

login.labelHint: Optional. Use a label that identifies the upstream account.
login.callbackHint: Approve in the browser, then paste the full callback URL from the address bar here.
login.callbackInvalid: Not a callback URL — it must contain code and state from this authorization, and must not be the authorization URL itself.
login.codeHint: Copy the authorization code shown by Google and paste it here.
login.codeInvalid: Enter the authorization code shown after approval.
login.cookieHint: Paste the full Cookie header or sessionKey. It is stored encrypted for the initial OAuth exchange and cookie-only re-login, and omitted from ordinary credential responses.
login.claudeWebCookieHint: Paste the full Cookie header or sessionKey. The server validates the session and discovers the chat-capable account UUID; the cookie and derived account data are stored encrypted.

errors.startDescription: The provider rejected the start step. Check the provider settings and retry.
errors.completeDescription: The code exchange failed. Check the callback URL and retry this step.
errors.pollDescription: The provider status check failed. Retry without starting over.
errors.deniedDescription: The provider denied or expired this device request. Start again to get a new code.
errors.cookieDescription: The provider rejected the cookie. Check it and retry this step.

models.title: Models this provider serves
models.description: Capability is recorded per provider. A load balancer advertises the conservative fold of its members.
models.empty: No models recorded for this provider.
models.thinkingHint: Switch on capabilities this upstream explicitly supports. Undeclared values stay unknown until changed.
models.instructionsHint: Instructions returned to Codex clients for this model.
models.unknownMetadata: Unknown; a later catalog pull may fill this value.
models.variantsHint: Variants expose additional model names that route to this base model. Each can force tools, reasoning, service tier, verbosity, or an upstream.

variantPicker.upstreamHint: Enter upstream slugs separated by commas.

models.pullSynced: Sync complete: {{models}} models saved, {{prices}} price overrides added.
models.pullDefaultPricesHint: Match the embedded model catalog and create exact price overrides for this provider; existing rules are preserved.
models.pullDescription: Fetch this provider's live model catalog, then choose which model metadata and default prices to import.
models.pullLoadingHint: Asking the provider for its current model catalog.
models.pullEmptyHint: Refresh to ask the provider again, or add a model manually.
models.pullNoMatchesHint: Try a different model name or clear the search.
